capabilities.title: System snapshot
capabilities.description: Read-only CPU / memory / disk / network summary from the local SystemMonitor services. No permission required; nothing leaves the Mac.

capabilities.title: Capture screen region
capabilities.description: Capture a user-selected screen region via the Screenshot service and return a local file path. Any transfer off the Mac requires a separate, user-approved share step.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Optional capture rect; omitted means interactive selection.

capabilities.title: Capture full screen
capabilities.description: Capture the full screen via the CommandBar screenshot action.

capabilities.title: Keep awake
capabilities.description: Toggle keep-awake, or pass minutes to keep awake for a fixed duration.

parameters.name: minutes
parameters.description: Optional duration; omitted toggles the current state.

capabilities.title: Toggle dark mode
capabilities.description: Switch the system appearance between light and dark via the CommandBar quick toggle.
